items.description: Translation of police report Spanish to English, 68 lines
items.rationale: Translating documents for the claim is excluded under 3.1.6 and 7.1.8(f), as Part 11.2 confirms.
These are working materials raised alongside the translation charge, excluded under 7.1.8(e) and (f).

Robbery under threat with a weapon is covered under 2.3.1. The expensive watch is capped at the EUR 2,500 per-item valuables sub-limit (no valuables schedule), and the cash (>EUR 800) at the EUR 500 means-of-payment sub-limit. The total of EUR 3,000 is within the EUR 5,000 away-from-premises limit; less the EUR 50 deductible this gives EUR 2,950.
Forwarding and carriage charges are excluded under 7.1.8(b).
